subject: Opening request: Senior Inference Lead — hiring gate coordination
messages:
From: sofia@talentbridge.io (Sofia Martinez)
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Potential candidate — Alex Taylor (Senior Inference Lead) / Request to open headcount

Hi Markus,

Following our call this morning, sharing Alex Taylor's profile — senior staff-level inference engineer currently leading model serving at Acme Analytics. Alex flagged interest in a role focused on production inference reliability and compaction/quantization work. Sofia attaching the candidate resume and a proposed JD with a couple of tweaks to match Redwood language (sent: JD_Senior_Inference_Lead_v2.pdf).

Quick context:
- Current title: Senior Inference Engineer, Acme Analytics (hands-on infra + people lead for a small team)
- Notice: 4–6 weeks
- Compensation expectations: open to market benchmark (we discussed 220–260k base + equity/stretch) — he cares about ownership of inference stack and roadmap.

Can you confirm whether we can open a new senior headcount (team X) or if you prefer a backfill vs expansion conversation? If we get a go-ahead, Alex is available for a 30–45 min interview the week of May 11.

Attachments: JD_Senior_Inference_Lead_v2.pdf, org_chart_team_x.png

Thanks,
Sofia Martinez
Principal Recruiter | TalentBridge
sofia@talentbridge.io | +1 415-555-0184
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: sofia@talentbridge.io
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Potential candidate — Alex Taylor (Senior Inference Lead) / Request to open headcount

Sofia — thanks for the intro and the materials.

Quick answers:
- I want to avoid creating an unbudgeted expansion right now; prefer to align this with a backfill or a formally approved headcount increase.
- Where possible, can this role be framed as a replacement/backfill for the role Lydia left (team X)? It maps well to the responsibilities.
- If we proceed as backfill, please route through Hiring Gate (I copied Mina and Laura).

Mina / Laura — can you weigh in on: budget/approval for backfill vs expansion, and any constraints on level? If we can slot it as a backfill, I’m supportive of moving quickly — Alex’s background looks strong and leadership wants to protect momentum on latency/kv-cache work.

Also: please ask People Ops to validate comp bands while this thread is live. I attached the draft JD for any language edits.

— Markus Klein
Director, Serving Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 13:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Potential candidate — Alex Taylor (Senior Inference Lead) / Request to open headcount

Markus — thanks for the context. My read: this maps to Lydia's prior scope and we should treat as backfill for headcount purposes. Budget: approved against hiring reserve for Q2 (we have margin in platform hires). Level: hire as Senior / Staff (IC4/IC5) depending on panel feedback.

Next steps:
1) Laura to run Hiring Gate checklist and confirm People Ops banding + comp spreadsheet.
2) Jordan to coordinate interview panel availability (I think we should include one systems infra, one applied-ML infra, and one PM partner).
3) If the panel recommends Staff-level, we will circulate a brief escalation note to execs before offer.

I am green to proceed as backfill. Please book initial interview once People Ops confirms bands.

Mina
VP, Platform & Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Potential candidate — Alex Taylor (Senior Inference Lead) / Request to open headcount

Looping back with People Ops update. I pinged Marcus in HR — People Ops confirmed the banding range, and I attached the offer benchmarking sheet (offer-benchmark-sheet.xlsx). They mentioned we should add a brief hiring rationale doc to the GH role before scheduling interviews.

Sofia — can you please:
- Confirm candidate availability windows for May 11–15 (and show times in PT and ET),
- Share the resume as a single PDF and confirm notice period again.

Jordan — can you propose a 60-minute panel slot (technical deep-dive + culture fit) and a 30-minute follow-up with product? Ideally one day, back-to-back.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of People Ops Recruiting | Redwood Inference
